desc: Ideation: reduce problem to max-bottleneck via Kruskal reconstruction tree; derive answer formula |Y−h*|+|Z−h*|, h* = min(b, max(Y,Z)); validate against samples.

Write the complete solution: fast input parsing, build grid edges (weight = min(F_u, F_v)), Kruskal descending to build the reconstruction tree, binary lifting with array('i') tables, LCA-based bottleneck queries, and per-query answer |Y−h*| + |Z−h*| with h* = min(bottleneck, max(Y, Z)) (bottleneck = ∞ when start and target blocks coincide).

Review code for correctness and edge cases: u==v same block different floors, H=1 or W=1 line grids, N=1 (no edges, KRT root = single leaf), memory of lifting tables (~500k × 19 ints via array('i')), iterative DFS to avoid recursion limits, and confirm sample outputs 10 and 2.
